correctness.rationale:
Independently reconstructed the trace identity and all optimizer comparisons. For a cut pendant edge, the diagonal difference after restoring the edge is (p-q)/(1+p+q), where p=1/alpha and q is the adjacent inverse diagonal in the connected remaining tree. The Laplacian spectral decomposition gives q

=3 it is strictly increasing on x>=0 with exactly one positive root and all leaves tie there. The root equation x(m+2+x)=2/(m-2) gives m^2 x -> 2 and gives (sqrt(33)-5)/2 at m=3. Symmetric stable dynamics give trace equal to half the inverse diagonal by integrating e^{-2t(L+alpha I)}.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact example of reversal of the optimal trace-Gramian site under uniform damping alone, with the graph, metric and input magnitude held fixed. The threshold, equality class, and m^-2 scale quantify when a low-damping site ranking ceases to be reliable; they are not supplied by modularity or degree. The margin formula allows comparison without computing the full inverse.
residual_risks: Specific tree family and trace criterion; this is not an actuator-energy or general-tree theorem.
